facts.fact: Caspian 单膝贴地辨震：不是野马，是成队形奔跑的变异兽群，从南面的 Haven 方向来——南境已被突破。
facts.anchor: “Wild horses,” Caspian said, dropping to one knee and pressing his palm to the trembling earth.

facts.fact: 三继承人无需商议、无需交换眼神，身体自行在她面前排成三道墙。
facts.anchor: The three heirs placed themselves in front of me. No discussion. No glance exchanged.

facts.fact: 她撕下臂甲，数百粒冷铁同时苏醒，金属在她手中分流成两枚十寸双轮刃。
facts.anchor: Two chakrams, ten inches in diameter, hummed against my skin.

facts.fact: 她向 Aelindor 说明兵器特性：冷铁会自行找靶，击杀后双轮刃飞回手中。
facts.anchor: “Coldiron will find the target for me, and when the chakram makes a kill, it’ll return to my hand.

facts.fact: 她击杀一头偷袭 Caspian 的变异狼后，近百头兽同时转向她，齐声发出同一调门的嚎叫，然后全线冲她。
facts.anchor: Every mutant on the field turned its head toward me.

facts.fact: 被龙爪抓上天后她用激将法：怕一年级学员坐你背上你跟不上？还是嫌重、嫌太聪明？
facts.anchor: “Afraid you can’t keep up with a first-year cadet on your back? Too heavy and clever for the mighty dragon?”

facts.fact: 她在龙背上以鳞片为踏钩锁住脚踝，随时准备继续投刃。
facts.anchor: I hooked my foot under a scale and locked my ankle in place.

facts.fact: 头狼那双人造疯狂的赤红眼后另有存在在窥视、丈量她——她怀疑正是 False Heir。
facts.anchor: Someone was watching me through those eyes, measuring me from across whatever distance separated us.

facts.fact: 兽群在同一瞬间停手，齐向南望、同调嚎叫，弃尸南逃——如开关被扳下。
facts.anchor: Their heads turned south. The same yowl rose from their throats, and then they ran.

facts.fact: 龙火两轮扫荡加上 Caspian 与斯巴达人侧翼合围，三十余头逃兽无一越过山脊。
facts.anchor: None made it past the ridge.
